bullets.title: the XPO Trainer
bullets.note:
Recommended to me by elite powerlifter Mark Bell (check his other gear
[here](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/q1opyg/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaG93bXVjaHlhYmVuY2gubmV0Lw==);
our podcast together
[here](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/x1zvjk/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzA3LzEyL2luc2lkZS10aGUtd29ybGQtb2Ytc3VwZXJ0cmFpbmluZy1tYXJrLWJlbGwv)),
it is effectively a “prowler” with mechanical resistance. I was initially
skeptical, but now it’s one of my favorite torture tools. The harder you push,
the harder it gets, and the wheels allow me to easily use this anywhere.
Unexpectedly, it is much more difficult to use on asphalt than, say, grass,
gravel, or loose surfaces, which suits my urban environment perfectly, and no
weight plates are required. The XPO is not made in high volume, and it’s a bit
expensive, so here are [a few
alternatives](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/e1pnyl/aHR0cDovL2Ftem4udG8vMnZNdzUzcg==)
if needed. Bonus: If you want to see a walk-through of Mark’s incredible gym,
[here’s a
video](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/41xkjn/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzAyLzA1L3J1c3QtYW5kLWlyb24tZXBpc29kZS0yLXBvd2VybGlmdGVyLW1hcmstYmVsbC8=)
we shot together.**

bullets.title: Dr. Martin Gibala
bullets.note:
as prescribed by [Dr. Martin
Gibala](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/ly60ym/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzAxLzIzL3RoZS1vbmUtbWludXRlLXdvcmtvdXQtZGVzaWduZWQtYnktc2NpZW50aXN0cy1kci1tYXJ0aW4tZ2liYWxhLw==),
one of the world’s foremost exercise scientists (Podcast: “[The One-Minute
Workout Designed by
Scientists](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/gykm1o/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzAxLzIzL3RoZS1vbmUtbWludXRlLXdvcmtvdXQtZGVzaWduZWQtYnktc2NpZW50aXN0cy1kci1tYXJ0aW4tZ2liYWxhLw==)”).
Most recently, I’ve been using the above XPO/prowler on asphalt with straight
arms (at about 50% max grip height) to remove the variability of arm position.
I find stationary biking about as interesting as watching paint dry, and the
prowler is lower impact. I also suspect there will be some nice carryover to
handstand work. Totally love it.**

bullets.title: The Four-Letter Code to Selling Just About Anything
bullets.creator: Derek Thompson
bullets.note:
([@DKThomp](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/4zup485rraehp9m5r/412oy0/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9ka3Rob21w))
of _The Atlantic_. How can you learn to sell anything? Study an immigrant who
did exactly that, of course. This piece is mostly biography but sprinkled with
enough how-to that you can apply it to your own businesses (e.g. Spotify case
study). Which is related to my next bullet...**
